purpose: Source ledger for contextual editorial review and platform adapters. This is not an AI-authorship detector.

evidence_grades.A-scoped: Primary research; only the reviewed study scope is supported. Abstract/metadata review is disclosed.
evidence_grades.B: Primary editorial or university guidance; supports a writing practice, not authorship inference.
evidence_grades.C: Community observation or firsthand anecdote; supports that a concern was reported, not its prevalence or cause.
evidence_grades.H: Historical primary text; existence counterexample or historical discussion, not a modern rule.
evidence_grades.D: Official documentation checked live; not a runtime compatibility result.
evidence_grades.J: Original editorial judgment; no external empirical validation claimed.

examples_policy: Unless explicitly labelled as a short historical quotation, all pattern examples and revisions in the taxonomy are original constructed illustrations. They are not user text, research findings, or historical quotations.

source_coverage.wikipedia: Opened community advice guide and selected relevant sections; not a complete audit of all page claims or linked studies.
source_coverage.reddit: Two public threads and visible comments opened; not a representative sample or authenticated platform-wide search.
source_coverage.developer_community: One public first-person 2024 formatting report opened.
source_coverage.university_guides: UNC writing-center evidence, concision, transitions and Purdue email guide opened.
source_coverage.historical: Digitized Strunk, Orwell Foundation essay and Gutenberg Lincoln transcription opened.
source_coverage.x: Not examined. No authenticated X access used; no claims attributed to X.
source_coverage.linkedin: Not examined. No authenticated LinkedIn access used; no claims attributed to LinkedIn.
source_coverage.papers: Three abstract/metadata pages reviewed; no methods audit, corpus reanalysis, or detector benchmark reproduction.
source_coverage.platforms: Official pages opened on checked_date; installation, invocation, file access, and end-to-end writing quality remain unexecuted.

sources.title: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing
sources.reviewed: Opened guide, introduction, caveats, content, syntax, and style sections.
sources.supports: Observational inventory: promotional significance, superficial explanation, vague attribution, negative parallelisms, triplets, conversational residue, citation problems.
sources.limitations: WikiProject advice, explicitly not Wikipedia policy; descriptive observations do not prove authorship or define universal editing rules.

sources.title: How to stop ChatGPT from using bold font too much?
sources.reviewed: Opened post and visible comments.
sources.supports: A user reports unwanted bold emphasis despite requested section-heading-only formatting.
sources.limitations: Self-selected anecdote; no controlled prompts, prevalence measurement, diagnosis, or current model guarantee.

sources.title: Chatgpt refuses to follow format instructions
sources.reviewed: Opened post and visible comments.
sources.supports: A user reports numbered lists and bold text conflicting with a conversational format request.
sources.limitations: Historical, self-selected complaint; not a universal objection to headings or lists and not a model evaluation.

sources.title: Chatgpt refuses to format responses correctly
sources.reviewed: Opened text of September 19, 2024 post and visible follow-up.
sources.supports: Developer-community participant reports difficulty enforcing plain conversational formatting.
sources.limitations: User report hosted in a vendor forum, not official documentation, a confirmed product defect, or independent experimental evidence.

sources.title: Writing Concisely
sources.reviewed: Opened UNC Writing Center handout.
sources.supports: Concision is audience-sensitive; removing redundancy and unnecessary qualifiers may help, while deliberate repetition and rhythm can be retained.
sources.limitations: Normative editorial advice, not evidence of AI authorship or a command to delete every qualifier.

sources.title: Evidence
sources.reviewed: Opened UNC Writing Center handout.
sources.supports: Claims need appropriate evidence, and evidence needs explanation connecting it to the argument.
sources.limitations: Discipline and assignment determine what counts as evidence; not an automatic factuality test.

sources.title: Transitions
sources.reviewed: Opened UNC Writing Center handout.
sources.supports: Transitions signal logical relationships; adding them cannot repair an incoherent organization.
sources.limitations: Does not support banning transition words or imposing a single paragraph shape.

sources.title: Email Etiquette
sources.reviewed: Opened email guidance, first contact and continuing conversation sections.
sources.supports: Clear subject lines, short direct paragraphs, appropriate greetings, and cordial tone serve professional correspondence.
sources.limitations: Recipient, power relationship, culture, and prior exchange matter; page copyright range alone does not date every recommendation before 2018.

sources.title: Word list, Google developer documentation style guide
sources.reviewed: Opened overview and word-list usage instructions.
sources.supports: Technical terminology and alternatives depend on audience, product, and prevailing convention.
sources.limitations: A vendor's house style is context-specific; this project does not import its entire avoid/don't-use list.

sources.title: Lists, Google developer documentation style guide
sources.reviewed: Opened list/table guidance and list types.
sources.supports: Numbered lists suit ordered procedures; bullets suit nonsequential collections; structure should carry meaning.
sources.limitations: Documentation-specific guidance; lists, headings, and parallel syntax are often useful.

sources.title: How do I cite generative AI in MLA style? (Updated and Revised)
sources.reviewed: Opened guide, source verification section, and publication date (August 13, 2025).
sources.supports: Consult original linked sources because generated references and summaries can be wrong; disclose AI use as applicable.
sources.limitations: Citation convention is MLA-specific; source existence and claim support must be checked separately.

sources.title: The Elements of Style, William Strunk Jr.
sources.reviewed: Opened digitized text, title/copyright pages, contents, and composition rules.
sources.supports: Copyrights 1918/1919/1920; guide discusses specificity, wordiness, paragraphs, parallel form, sentence variety, and punctuation.
sources.limitations: Historical editorial preferences, not universal rules; no invented taxonomy example is claimed to be a quotation from this book.

sources.title: Politics and the English Language, George Orwell
sources.reviewed: Opened Foundation-hosted essay and examples of prose criticized in 1946.
sources.supports: Vagueness, stock expressions, inflated language, and stale imagery were editorial concerns well before modern LLMs.
sources.limitations: The essay has a political/rhetorical purpose; its preferences do not establish universal modern style rules.

sources.title: Lincoln's Gettysburg Address
sources.reviewed: Opened transcription labelled November 19, 1863.
sources.supports: The address supplies a pre-2018 human counterexample for triplets, repetition, contrast, and elevated ceremonial rhetoric.
sources.limitations: Use as an existence counterexample, not proof that every contemporary use is effective; transcription punctuation can differ from manuscripts.

sources.title: Delving into LLM-assisted writing in biomedical publications through excess vocabulary
sources.reviewed: Opened arXiv abstract and version/journal metadata; full paper methods and data were not audited.
sources.supports: Authors infer aggregate LLM-associated vocabulary changes in biomedical abstracts.
sources.limitations: Corpus-level statistical association does not identify authorship of a sentence, justify a word blacklist, or transfer automatically to other genres.

sources.title: GPT detectors are biased against non-native English writers
sources.reviewed: Opened arXiv abstract and author/version metadata; no local replication.
sources.supports: Authors report misclassification of non-native English writing in detectors and samples they examined.
sources.limitations: Historical study of particular systems and English samples; not a measured false-positive rate for this package or every current detector.

sources.title: Different Time, Different Language: Revisiting the Bias Against Non-Native Speakers in GPT Detectors
sources.reviewed: Opened arXiv abstract and EACL 2026 Student Research Workshop metadata; no local replication.
sources.supports: Authors report no systematic non-native bias in the Czech setting and detector families they examined.
sources.limitations: Different language, period, and systems from Liang et al.; not grounds to assume universal fairness or universal bias.

sources.title: Agent Skills specification
sources.reviewed: Opened format, required fields, naming constraints, progressive disclosure, and optional directories.
sources.supports: Portable skills contain SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter and Markdown; name and description are required by the standard.
sources.limitations: The specification is not an installer, a sandbox, or proof of identical execution across hosts.

sources.title: Build skills, official OpenAI documentation
sources.reviewed: Opened official page after official-domain search; previous Codex URL resolves to current documentation.
sources.supports: Codex local discovery uses .agents/skills in repository ancestry and ~/.agents/skills for user skills; explicit and implicit invocation are documented.
sources.limitations: Documentation checked live, platform installation and writing workflow not executed.

sources.title: Extend Claude with skills
sources.reviewed: Opened official loading locations, invocation, and frontmatter sections.
sources.supports: Personal ~/.claude/skills and project .claude/skills; /skill-name and model selection are documented.
sources.limitations: Claude-specific fields and lifecycle differ; installation and workflow not executed.

sources.title: Agent skills, Google Antigravity Docs
sources.reviewed: Opened overview, default/legacy note, and App/CLI/IDE location tables.
sources.supports: Current default is .agents/skills; .agent/skills remains legacy-compatible; shared global location is ~/.gemini/config/skills.
sources.limitations: Version-sensitive; CLI has additional locations. No Google Antigravity runtime execution performed.

sources.title: Moving your custom GPT workflows to plugins
sources.reviewed: Opened official Custom GPT/plugin comparison and migration guidance.
sources.supports: Custom GPTs use instructions and uploaded knowledge; current ChatGPT also has native skills/plugins on documented surfaces.
sources.limitations: No Custom GPT created, no upload performed, no account capability or rollout availability tested.

failed_or_excluded.note: Used the opened Gutenberg Lincoln transcription instead; no claim relies on the inaccessible LOC page.
